snapshot_note: Point-in-time read of live lane trees; live seats may add or change files after generated_utc. Re-run scan.py to refresh.

method.lane_set: directories matching *-shokunin directly under the fleet root (not symlinks, not dot-prefixed); tameshi-shokukin reported separately as outside_lane_glob
method.walk: os.walk(<lane>/.ufo/waves, followlinks=False); symlinks recorded and not followed; only regular files named *.json are candidates
method.membership: top-level JSON object with schema == ufo-swarm-wave-dispatch-v1; other parseable JSON -> ignored_json; unparseable -> unreadable_json
method.wave: top-level wave (null when absent or JSON null)
method.task_count: len(taskCall.tasks); 0 when taskCall is JSON null (no-spawn); null when the taskCall key is missing or malformed
method.resume_sends: len(resumeSends) (actual entries); null when the key is missing
method.checks: consistency flags; names are self-describing (see field checks per dispatch)
method.sha256: over the raw bytes read during the scan
